categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在Agent多轮能力评测、知识图谱检索与记忆压缩，以及模型高效适配和工程逆向设计等方向。

articles.title: FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
articles.zh: FPTR：面向时延约束下联合波束与资源分配的可行性保持事务式精化方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做波束与资源的联合调度，这套方法保证每一步精化都不破坏可行性约束，硬时延场景下比"先优化再修补"稳得多
articles.author: Minghao Kong, Zirong Liu 等
articles.body: Short-interval wireless schedulers must return a complete, feasible beam-and-resource allocation before each execution deadline, and a late or invalid output gives no utility in the current control cycle. Searching longer can increase transmitted traffic, but it may also miss the deadline or leave only an infeasible intermediate solution. We propose Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement (FPTR), which always keeps a validated feasible allocation, the incumbent. Each refinement stage builds a separate candidate and leaves the incumbent unchanged. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is complete, passes the feasibility validator before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective; otherwise it is discarded. Four refinement stages use this rule: buffer-aware resource selection, compatibility-group (CG) user sharing, beam-mask rebuilding from remaining demand, and joint reassignment of two resources. On 150 fixed synthetic instances, the full pipeline (Full) raises traffic by 3.83% on average over a lightweight beam-first reference and by 1.79% over its Base constructor. In a separate suite with matched inputs, Full exceeds six independent search baselines (ALNS, tabu search, GA, simulated annealing, iterated local search, and GRASP) by 6.68-8.35%, where outputs later than 100 ms receive zero utility. All 750 Full runs in the internal suite returned feasible allocations, and none exceeded 100 ms. Separating mandatory output construction from optional refinement lets spare computation time improve the allocation without endangering the incumbent. The open-source implementation supports independent reproduction.
articles.bodyZh: 短间隔无线调度器（short-interval wireless schedulers）得在每个执行截止时间（deadline）前，交出一套完整、能落地的波束与资源分配（beam-and-resource allocation）方案；一旦交晚了或者方案不合法，在当前控制周期里就一点用都没有。多搜一会儿，可能让传输流量更高，但也可能错过截止时间，或者只留下一个不可行的中间解。我们提出保留可行性的“事务式”细化（Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement, FPTR）：它始终保留一套已经验证过的可行分配，也就是当前可行解（incumbent）。每个细化阶段单独构造一个候选解（candidate），并且不动当前可行解。候选解只有在完整、在本阶段截止时间（stage cutoff）前通过可行性校验器（feasibility validator），并且严格改善目标值（objective）时，才替换当前可行解；否则直接丢掉。四个细化阶段都按这个规则来：缓冲区感知资源选择（buffer-aware resource selection）、兼容组（compatibility-group, CG）用户共享、根据剩余需求重建波束掩码（beam-mask rebuilding），以及两个资源的联合重分配（joint reassignment）。在150个固定合成实例（synthetic instances）上，完整流程（Full）相比轻量级波束优先参考方案（lightweight beam-first reference），传输流量平均提高3.83%；相比它的基础构造器（Base constructor）提高1.79%。在另一组输入匹配的测试集里，Full比六个独立搜索基线（search baselines）——ALNS、禁忌搜索、遗传算法、模拟退火、迭代局部搜索和GRASP——高出6.68%到8.35%；在这个测试里，超过100毫秒才输出的结果效用（utility）为零。内部测试集里全部750次Full运行都返回了可行分配，而且没有一次超过100毫秒。把必须输出的构造和可选的细化分开，就能让多出来的计算时间用来改善分配，同时不危及当前可行解。开源实现（open-source implementation）支持独立复现。

articles.title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
articles.zh: 模型合并并不要求LoRA秩保持一致
articles.summary: 如果你手里攒了一堆不同秩的LoRA适配器以为没法直接合，这篇说明异构秩照样能合并，省掉统一秩重训那一轮
articles.author: Zirong Xie, Zainab Afolabi 等
articles.body: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. Merging keeps only a fixed share of the pooled spectral components, and methods that choose them by size discard many that would have reduced loss. They also tend to discard the same expert: the instruction adapter has the smallest singular values, so it is dropped almost entirely and IFEval falls by 16 to 25 pp. Choosing components by their effect on loss instead keeps all three experts, and leaves accuracy nearly flat across an 8$\times$ rank range (0.7 pp, against 6.7 pp for TIES at 4B scale). Rank can therefore be chosen per expert whenever the merge operator does not select by magnitude.
articles.bodyZh: 模型合并（model merging）能把各自单独微调过的专家模型（fine-tuned experts）合成一个模型，而且不用重新训练。常见做法是让每个专家都用同一个 LoRA 秩（LoRA rank），这就把不同专家的秩选择绑在一起了，可每个领域其实都有自己最合适的秩。我们证明这种绑定是合并方法（merge method）本身的特性，不是合并不行。我们在数学、指令跟随、多语言这三个领域上，用四种秩和三种模型规模训练了 36 个专家，然后用六种方法分别按统一秩、以及按每个领域自己的最佳秩去合并。结果发现，给专家用不同秩，对平均法和基于效用的选择法没有任何损失，反而最多能提升 1.8 个百分点的多领域准确率；而冲突消解方法（conflict-resolution methods）表现不稳定，最多会掉 4 个百分点。这种差距原因很简单：合并时只保留汇总谱成分（spectral components）里固定比例的一部分，而按大小来挑成分的方法会丢掉很多本来能降低损失的成分。它们还往往丢的是同一个专家：指令适配器（instruction adapter）的奇异值（singular values）最小，所以几乎被整个丢掉，IFEval 会掉 16 到 25 个百分点。改成按成分对损失的影响来选，就能把三个专家都保住，准确率在 8 倍的秩范围里几乎不变（只差 0.7 个百分点；在 4B 规模上，TIES 是 6.7 个百分点）。所以，只要合并算子（merge operator）不是按数值大小来挑，就可以给每个专家单独选秩。

articles.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
articles.zh: 多轮强化学习究竟提升了LLM Agent的什么能力？
articles.summary: 如果你准备用多轮RL训Agent，先看这篇搞清楚涨的分到底来自哪项能力，别把评测波动当成方法有效
articles.author: Kejian Zhu, Zhuoran Jin 等
articles.body: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
articles.bodyZh: 多轮智能体强化学习（multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning, RL）在长程任务上确实很能打，但它的性能提升对交互限制特别敏感。我们用 Pass@(K,T) 从采样广度（sampling breadth）K 和交互深度（interaction depth）T 两个维度来评估，发现轨迹级（trajectory-level）的 RL 优势得靠足够的轮次预算（turn budgets）撑着，预算一收紧，效果就明显掉下来。另外，智能体 RL 并不是把每一步的决策质量都均匀拉高；它的强项更多集中在出错后的恢复能力，以及长程任务里的抗压能力。为了降低这种“预算依赖”带来的落地风险，我们先初步聊了聊过程监督信号（process supervision signals）的好处和局限，并提出 BudgetMix RL 作为一种替代方案——训练时让交互预算变起来。实验表明，BudgetMix RL 在各种不同的执行设置下都能保持稳健表现。项目主页：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

articles.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
articles.zh: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的Agent式组合检索
articles.summary: 如果你在做KG多跳问答，这套Agent拆解子查询再组合检索的路子值得借鉴，重点看它怎么规划检索路径
articles.author: Jyotin Goel, Abhinav Arun 等
articles.body: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
articles.bodyZh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）是靠在一个从语料库（corpus）里搭出来的知识图谱（knowledge graph）上做检索来回答问题的。但现在的检索策略，基本都是围着自己那套建图流程产出的结构来设计的；一旦建图方式变了，它还能不能好用，很少有人真的去测。我们研究的正是这种“跨建图方式的可迁移性”（cross-construction portability）：同一套检索流程，在不依赖特定建图方案的模式（schema）、关系名（relation names），也不重新调参（retuning）的情况下，换一种方式建图后还能不能保持有效。我们提出了 ArcRAG：它会在推理时（inference time）临时归纳出一个“只服务当前查询”的图接口（query-local graph interface），也就是从问题里提到的实体出发，能摸到哪些节点标签（node labels）、关系描述（relation descriptors）和属性键（property keys）；然后基于这个接口规划多跳遍历（multi-hop traversals），再用 Cypher 查询语言执行，并在出错时修复。我们把 MuSiQue、HotpotQA、TriviaQA 这三个语料库分别建成两种图：一种是模式引导的图（schema-guided graph），节点有类型（typed nodes）、关系集合是封闭的（closed relation set），还带来源出处（source provenance）；另一种是开放信息抽取图（open-information-extraction graph），节点不分类型（untyped nodes），关系是自由文本（free-text relations）。两种图下，检索器的配置都保持不变。我们拿一个不依赖具体建图方式的 Direct-Cypher 智能体（agent）做对比；在两类图上，分别用不同的重试次数和轮次预算（retry and pass budgets）对每个阶段做消融（ablate）；也和之前 GraphRAG 系统报告的结果比，不过这些系统大多是把检索和自家建图方案绑在一起设计的。在这两种建图方式下，我们发现：检索并不一定非得和建图一起联合设计。查询时再归纳接口（query-time interface induction），能让一个不依赖具体建图方式的检索器（construction-agnostic retriever）在建图方式变化时依然有效；不过，建图方式本身仍然会影响绝对准确率（absolute accuracy）。

articles.title: Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
articles.zh: 基于不确定性引导框架的微液滴发生器代理模型增强与逆向设计
articles.summary: 如果你做微流控器件的逆向设计，用不确定性引导能让代理模型少喝仿真数据，别再无脑堆样本了
articles.author: David Gabriel Harispe, Matías Gerard 等
articles.body: Microfluidic droplet generation is critical for many applications, yet efficient device design in high-dimensional parameter spaces remains computationally prohibitive due to complex multiphase flow dynamics. This work presents a unified methodology that couples adaptive surrogate enhancement with simulation-driven inverse design. High-fidelity Volume-of-Fluid simulations provide ground-truth data, while neural network ensembles predict flow regimes and droplet diameters. Ensemble-based uncertainty quantification identifies epistemic uncertainty using consensus levels for regime classification and the coefficient of variation for diameter prediction, revealing that uncertainty concentrates near regime transition boundaries where physics is highly sensitive to parameter perturbations. A physics-informed enrichment strategy targets these critical zones and addresses class imbalances by deploying additional targeted simulations and retraining the surrogates forming the ensembles. A framework that integrates Particle Swarm Optimization for constrained inverse design, balancing accuracy with predictive confidence and physical consistency is therefore proposed. Validation on independent test datasets demonstrates that the enriched ensembles achieve higher accuracy, with the fraction of predictions within the 0-3% error range on droplet diameter nearly doubling, and high-error cases (above 10%) dropping substantially. The inverse design procedure reliably identifies physically realizable configurations meeting target droplet sizes. This approach significantly reduces computational costs while ensuring reliable predictions, offering a framework with potential applicability to the optimization of a broad range of microfluidic systems.
articles.bodyZh: 微流控液滴生成（microfluidic droplet generation）在很多应用里都很关键，但想在高维参数空间（high-dimensional parameter spaces）里高效设计器件，计算量还是大到不太现实，因为多相流动力学（multiphase flow dynamics）太复杂了。这项工作提出了一套统一方法，把自适应代理模型增强（adaptive surrogate enhancement）和仿真驱动逆向设计（simulation-driven inverse design）结合起来。高保真流体体积法（Volume-of-Fluid）仿真负责提供基准真值数据，神经网络集成（neural network ensembles）负责预测流态和液滴直径。基于集成的不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification）会利用流态分类里的共识水平（consensus levels），以及直径预测里的变异系数（coefficient of variation），来找出认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）；结果发现，不确定性主要集中在流态转换边界附近，因为那里的物理过程对参数扰动特别敏感。物理信息增强策略（physics-informed enrichment strategy）会专门盯住这些关键区域，并通过增加定向仿真、重新训练组成集成的代理模型，来处理类别不平衡问题。于是，作者提出了一个框架，把粒子群优化（Particle Swarm Optimization）用于约束逆向设计（constrained inverse design），在精度、预测置信度和物理一致性之间找平衡。用独立测试数据集做验证后可以看到，增强后的集成模型精度更高：液滴直径预测落在0%到3%误差范围内的比例几乎翻倍，而误差高于10%的高误差案例大幅减少。这套逆向设计流程能可靠地找到满足目标液滴尺寸、并且在物理上可实现的配置。说白了，这种方法能显著降低计算成本，同时保证预测可靠，也给广泛微流控系统的优化提供了一个有潜力推广的框架。

articles.title: Within-Family EfficientNet Scaling under Fixed-Resolution Transfer Learning for Spectral-Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Retinal Disease Classification
articles.zh: 固定分辨率迁移学习下EfficientNet族内缩放用于频域OCT视网膜疾病分类
articles.summary: 如果你在OCT影像上纠结选EfficientNet哪一档，这篇提醒你固定输入分辨率下族内放大的收益有限，先调别的变量
articles.author: Shkelqim Sherifi
articles.body: Background/Objectives: CNNs perform well in retinal disease classification from spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT), but whether EfficientNet's natural-image scaling hierarchy transfers to medical-image transfer learning at fixed resolution remains unclear. This study evaluates EfficientNet-B0-B7 for four-class SD-OCT classification and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Methods: Eight ImageNet-pretrained variants (4.05-64.10M instantiated backbone parameters) were evaluated at 224x224 on the Kermany dataset. Grayscale images were replicated to RGB and processed using model-embedded preprocessing and augmentation. Training comprised frozen-backbone head training followed by partial fine-tuning. Metrics covered classification, discrimination, efficiency, and visual analyses. Results: Test accuracy varied non-monotonically from 95.93% (B0) to 96.95% (B1); B7 achieved 96.73%. B1 had the highest accuracy and Drusen F1 (0.8780), while B7 had Drusen F1 of 0.8720 and the highest Drusen recall (0.9177). Drusen had the lowest F1 across all variants and contributed 82.2% of the summed squared deviation in class-specific F1; class ranking remained Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen. The OCT accuracy ranking differed from the reported ImageNet hierarchy, where B7 ranked first. The accuracy-to-parameter ratio fell from 19.82 to 1.48 percentage points per million total parameters. The final train-test gap had a weak, non-significant association with test accuracy (r = 0.26, p = 0.53). Conclusions: Larger EfficientNet variants did not consistently improve SD-OCT classification. B1 achieved the highest accuracy and Drusen F1, whereas B7 showed a secondary accuracy recovery at greater model size and CPU latency, indicating task and protocol dependent scaling effects. As cross-partition duplicates have not been independently audited, results are conditional on the supplied split.
articles.bodyZh: 背景/目标：CNN在基于谱域光学相干断层扫描（SD-OCT）的视网膜疾病分类中表现不错，但EfficientNet那套在自然图像上设计的缩放层级，在固定分辨率下能否迁移到医学图像的迁移学习上，目前还不清楚。本研究评估EfficientNet-B0到B7在四分类SD-OCT任务上的表现，以及准确率和效率之间的权衡关系。方法：在Kermany数据集上，以224x224的输入尺寸，评估了八个ImageNet预训练变体（实例化主干参数量4.05到64.10M）。灰度图像复制成RGB三通道，用模型内置的预处理和增强流程处理。训练分两步：先冻结主干只训练分类头，再做部分微调。评估指标覆盖分类性能、判别能力、效率和可视化分析。结果：测试准确率并不是单调变化的，从B0的95.93%到B1的96.95%；B7达到96.73%。B1的准确率最高，Drusen类的F1也最高（0.8780）；B7的Drusen F1为0.8720，但Drusen召回率最高（0.9177）。Drusen在所有变体里F1都是最低的，在各类别F1的平方偏差总和里贡献了82.2%；类别排名始终是正常 > CNV > DME > Drusen。OCT上的准确率排名和之前报道的ImageNet层级不一样——在ImageNet上排第一的是B7。准确率与参数量的比值从每百万总参数19.82个百分点降到1.48个百分点。最终训练-测试差距和测试准确率之间只有微弱且不显著的关联（r = 0.26，p = 0.53）。结论：更大的EfficientNet变体并没有持续提升SD-OCT分类性能。B1取得了最高准确率和Drusen F1，而B7在更大模型规模和更高CPU延迟下出现了次级的准确率回升，说明缩放效果取决于任务和实验协议。由于跨分区的重复样本还没有经过独立审核，以上结果仅在给定数据划分下成立。

articles.title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Benchmark for HTML-based Visually Rich Document parsing
articles.zh: AmbiHTMLBench：面向HTML视觉丰富文档解析的基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做文档解析，HTML类视觉富文档一直缺统一评测，这个基准可以直接拿来当对照基线
articles.author: Boyu Niu, Yingjie Xiong 等
articles.body: Traditional document parsing systems use Markdown as their output representation, which is effective for linear text but does not fully preserve fine-grained spatial structure, table geometry, visual hierarchy, or rendering semantics. We show that HTML is advantageous for heterogeneous and layout-sensitive documents whose representations must remain editable, inspectable, and reusable, and introduce AmbiHTMLBench to systematically study this setting. In this benchmark, given a real-world document, a model must recover executable HTML that preserves its content, organization, and visual appearance. The benchmark contains 1,115 diverse pages with structured annotations and evaluates predictions in two different ways: The objective protocol aligns ground-truth and predicted rendered blocks and measures table fidelity, page-level text error, and a two-dimensional layout consistency; a complementary reference-anchored protocol measures perceived fidelity by aligning LLM judges with human preferences. Across ten primary multimodal systems, the best objective score is 0.8092, while the subjective winner is different, demonstrating that automatic decomposition and human-perceived fidelity capture complementary properties. We further fine-tune a small-parameter expert model and find that task-specific adaptation yields good performance on document-to-HTML reconstruction task. These results position AmbiHTMLBench as a diagnostic testbed for building smarter and more logical document parsing systems.
articles.bodyZh: 传统文档解析系统常把 Markdown 当输出形式，处理线性文本挺有效，但它没法完整保留细粒度的空间结构（spatial structure）、表格几何形状（table geometry）、视觉层级（visual hierarchy）和渲染语义（rendering semantics）。我们要说明，对于内容类型混杂、对排版敏感、而且输出表示还得能编辑、能检查、能复用的文档，HTML 更有优势；为此我们推出了 AmbiHTMLBench，用来系统研究这个场景。在这个基准里，给定一份真实文档，模型得还原出可执行的 HTML（executable HTML），既要保住内容、组织结构，也要保住视觉外观。这个基准包含 1,115 个多样化页面，并带有结构化标注（structured annotations）；它用两种方式评估预测结果：客观协议（objective protocol）会把标准答案和预测结果分别渲染后的块对齐，衡量表格保真度（table fidelity）、页面级文本错误（page-level text error），以及二维布局一致性（two-dimensional layout consistency）；另一套补充的、以参考为锚的协议（reference-anchored protocol），则通过让大语言模型（LLM）评判员和人类偏好对齐，来衡量感知保真度（perceived fidelity）。在十个主要的多模态（multimodal）系统上，最好的客观分数是 0.8092，但主观评选的赢家却不一样，这说明自动拆解和人类感知保真度抓到的是互补的特性。我们还微调了一个小参数专家模型（small-parameter expert model），发现针对任务做适配，能在文档转 HTML 重建任务上取得不错表现。这些结果让 AmbiHTMLBench 成为一个诊断型测试平台，用来构建更聪明、更有逻辑的文档解析系统。

articles.title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
articles.zh: SUMONE：面向即插即用Agent记忆的简洁高效摘要器
articles.summary: 如果你在搭Agent长期记忆又不想每次摘要都调大模型，这个轻量方案能直接塞进现有流程做记忆压缩
articles.author: Jizhe Zhang, Ang Li 等
articles.body: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.
articles.bodyZh: 长周期（long-horizon）的语言模型智能体（language-model agents）会越跑越攒下一大堆交互历史，所以必须做上下文压缩（context compaction），才能高效执行。现有的学习式压缩方法，往往得看下游任务结果或者求解器行为（solver behavior），这就把训练跟具体任务或具体智能体绑死了。我们提出 SumOne，一个独立的摘要器，靠掩码重建（masked reconstruction）来训练，目标是保住智能体历史里的信息。具体说，拿到一份“已经过期”的历史摘要后，再用一个冻结的重建器（reconstructor），把原始轨迹（trajectory）里随机被遮住的部分还原出来；还原得好不好，再配上一个长度惩罚（length penalty），就形成了一个跟具体任务无关（task-agnostic）的奖励，用 GRPO 来优化这个摘要器。这样就能直接从原始轨迹里拿到自监督（self-supervision）信号，不需要参考摘要，也不用真去跑下游任务。推理的时候只保留这个轻量摘要器，其他智能体一点不用改，就能即插即用（plug-and-play）地压缩上下文。我们在长周期搜索和软件工程任务里系统评估了 SumOne。跟用完整上下文跑相比，SumOne 在 DeepSearchQA 上把预估推理成本降了大约 78%，在 SWE-bench Verified 上降了 75%，而性能的绝对下降只有 0.04。同一个检查点（checkpoint）还能跨不同的下游模型和智能体运行框架（agent harness）直接迁移，不用额外微调。
